newsitem.title: USA: Optical Cable comment on Reuter error.
newsitem.headline: Optical Cable comment on Reuter error.

text.p: Optical Cable Announces Reuters News Article Correction

ROANOKE, Va.--(BUSINESS WIRE)--Dec. 20, 1996--Optical Cable Corp. (NASDAQ:OCCF) announced that yesterday Reuters news agency erroneously posted the fourth quarter results for Optical Coating Laboratory Inc (OCLI) against (OCCF). The poor fourth quarter results posted by mistake against Optical Cable Corporation probably caused some of our shareholders to sell yesterday. If you sold because of this bad data, please contact Reuters America, Mr. Patrick Rizzo, at 1-212-859-1400 for further assistance.
Optical Cable Corporation will post very strong actual fourth quarter earnings during the last week of 1996 or the first week of 1997.

Earlier the Company announced sales and earnings projections for 1997 through 1999. Sales estimates are based on existing market segments and not on any new market penetrations that may come to pass over that period of time. Earnings per share (EPS) is based on approximately 38.7 million shares currently outstanding and may vary from time to time. -0-

A new magazine called Bloomberg Personal ran a feature article in the January/February 1997 issue called Set to Soar, the Bloomberg 100 Best-Performing Stocks in 1996. Optical Cable Corporation was ranked in a tie for the 25th position. This ranking we accept with great honor, having just gone public with an IPO on April 2, 1996.
To all of our shareholders and customers globally, we wish you the very happiest of seasons greetings and prosperous New Year.

This press release contains "forward looking statements" as to expectations, beliefs and future financial performance and assumptions relating to sales and product demand. The actual results could differ materially based upon a number of factors, including changes in economic conditions, increased competition, loss of significant customers, timing of large orders and changes in product sales mix. -0-
